description: This Java class implements a stream processor using Akka streams that limits the rate of elements passing through based on a time window and maximum element count, rejecting excess elements.

classes.name: LimitRateByRejection
classes.description: A final utility class that provides a static method to create a graph which limits element passing rate based on time and count, rejecting additional elements via an error function.

classes.name: Logic
classes.description: A private static inner class implementing the rate limiting logic, tracking window timing and element count, and producing either accepted elements or error signals.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Public static method that creates a graph which enforces a rate limit on elements based on the specified time window, maximum elements per window, and an error reporting function.

methods.name: creator
methods.description: Static method returning a Creator for Logic instances, given the Duration, maximum elements, and error reporter function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Instance method of Logic class that processes each element to determine if it falls within the rate limit, or should be rejected with an error.
